messages:
Lina (partnerships): Proposal: run a 3-week 'Sandcastle' partner sandbox for ISV/tooling integrations (LangChain, LlamaIndex), gateway adaptors, orchestration runners, plus a couple HW SI partners. Lightweight goal: find integration nits early and produce a short co-demo. Key pieces: auto-provisioned test creds, simple manifest format, shared smoke harness, SSO options, and a small compute credit pool.

Zoe (devex): Love the name. Onboarding should be <15m with an inline checklist. We can add a 'one-click' dev key for initial testing. :white_check_mark: 

Diego (eng-runtime): Important: include a matrix for model variants + quant + seq lengths. HW partners will want throughput/latency numbers. Also flag any adapter KS issues (e.g., streaming + kv-cache edgecases).

Lina (partnerships): Diego, can you put together a minimal manifest sketch by Tue? keep it compact: model, seq_buckets, quant, perf_hint.

Diego (eng-runtime): Will do. Example manifest I'll drop in the repo: 

```json
{"model":"open/redwood-mini-1","seq_buckets":"[128,512,1024]","quant":"4bit-ptq","latency_ms_slo":"150"}
```

Zoe (devex): SSO: partners asked for both SAML (SP-init & IdP-init) and OIDC. We'll expose a toggle and a dev fallback. Need to capture callback URLs for gateway hooks too.

integrations-bot: Sandcastle CI snapshot: a100-x: 8/9 smoke tests passed, t4-small: 7/9 passed, arm-edge: 5/9 passed. Failures are memory regrowth on long sequence runs. Full trace: https://internal.reports/sandcastle/ci-0412

Priya (product): Marketing wants a co-demo and a short blog the week after closing. Legal: we'll need a short sandbox addendum (logs, retention, support SLA). Partnerships + Legal sync?

Noah (bizops): Funding note: allocate 30k partner compute credits and 2 demo travel/ops stipends. I'll file the request against the partner budget; expect PO windows.

Lina (partnerships): Owners: Partnerships = invites/comms; DevEx = onboarding + SSO; Eng-runtime = test harness + manifests; Product = co-demo + marketing; BizOps = credits/PO. Deadlines: manifest Tue, onboarding guide Fri, invites Wed.

Zoe (devex): I'll draft the onboarding doc and a quick smoke curl. Example: 

```bash
# basic smoke
curl -s -X POST https://sandbox.redwood.ai/v1/test \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $SANDCASTLE_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hi","model":"open/redwood-mini-1","max_tokens":40}'
```

Diego (eng-runtime): Note: that endpoint will exercise continuous batching. Warn partners to avoid high fan-out without autoscale hints. We'll add an "autoscale_hint" field to the manifest.

Lina (partnerships): Who can ping LangChain and LlamaIndex maintainers? want a quick yes/no before we send invites.

Priya (product): I'll reach out to LangChain. Lina, can you ping LlamaIndex and the gateway maintainers? I'll own the co-demo agenda once partners confirm.

Noah (bizops): I'll start the credit approval and check for any vendor PO requirements.

integrations-bot: Note: scheduled infra maintenance Friday 02:00-03:00 UTC. Avoid running long seq tests during that window.

Zoe (devex): Also adding SSO testcases (SP-init / IdP-init / OIDC authorization code). I can mock an IdP for partners that can't do SAML.

Diego (eng-runtime): Request: include HW contact list in the calendar invite so we can collect rack configs for on-prem runs. Lina, please attach.

Lina (partnerships): Will do. Next steps recap: (1) Diego opens manifest PR, (2) Zoe posts onboarding + smoke snippets, (3) Partnerships invites partners Wed, (4) Product drafts co-demo outline. I'll create a short Loom and calendar invite. Anything else?

Priya (product): Add a short feedback form at the end of the sandbox to collect integration blockers and product asks.

Noah (bizops): I'll also add a tiny stipend for SI demo ops (to cover staging time). Filing now.

Lina (partnerships): Great team. I'll follow up with a one-pager and invite. Thanks! :tada:
